svg.aria-label: A line drawing of a single string fixed at both ends to two walls. The same string is drawn in three modes at once — the fundamental with one antinode, the second harmonic with two and the third with three — each with its opposite phase as a grey dashed line. The fundamental is labelled “coder”, the second harmonic “reviewer” and the third “planner”. The string vibrates slowly, passing from one mode to the next.
